items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: I took orchestration lessons with a lady named Ariadna Mikeshina... I studied with her for six years

ctx.x: So on all these sessions, I’m just – this is a guess on my part but you were observing how producers worked.

Yeah. I was learning. I was learning how to produce and I was learning how to arrange for singers, I mean how to write when there’s a vocalist and I was paying attention to that. I was always a musical study. I was always studying. I took classical guitar lessons, I took orchestration lessons with a lady named Ariadna Mikeshina, she was a Russian composer. I studied with her for six years on my own so I didn’t go to college or anything but I did it on my own. I studied classical guitar and orchestration. And I…
And your scorepads, did you have a line for what the singer was actually singing?
